regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors, enterprise AI, healthcare and federal-services exposure, but several clusters rely partly on sentiment or affiliation rather than hard demand. With no completed track-record observations, conviction remains modest and near-extended or event-sensitive names are watches rather than entries.
regime_read_zh: 当前汇聚主要集中在半导体、企业AI、医疗及联邦服务敞口，但部分信号依赖情绪或关联关系，而非硬性需求。由于尚无已完成评分的历史判断，整体置信度保持克制，接近涨幅阈值或面临事件风险的标的仅列入观察。

theses.thesis: MU has the cleanest non-extended semiconductor alignment: buying disclosures span four congressional members, insider purchase pressure is strongly positive, patent activity is substantial, and government grants are accelerating [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [gov_grant_accel]. Ro Khanna's disclosed affiliation adds policy-network context, while bullish Stocktwits activity is supportive but should be treated as the weakest channel [actor:Ro Khanna] [stocktwits_bull].
theses.thesis_zh: MU呈现出最清晰的未过度上涨半导体汇聚：四名国会议员的披露交易形成买入集群，内部人士买入压力显著为正，专利活动较多，政府补助也在加速 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [gov_grant_accel]。Ro Khanna的披露关联提供政策网络背景，而Stocktwits看多情绪仅作为较弱的辅助信号 [actor:Ro Khanna] [stocktwits_bull]。
second_order: US memory-equipment suppliers — stronger memory investment would transmit into fabrication and test demand
Domestic semiconductor manufacturing — grant acceleration points to continued policy support for US capacity
AI-server memory — sustained compute deployment would increase demand for high-bandwidth memory
theses.dissent: MU has underperformed SPY over 60 days, so the signals may reflect an attempted bottom rather than improving end demand.

falsifier.text: Government support loses momentum and subsequent disclosures show insider or congressional buying reversing while relative performance continues to deteriorate.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: MSFT's signals span measured product demand, developer activity and intellectual-property creation: highly rated applications with a very large review base, strong model-download activity, substantial GitHub engagement and a large patent cluster [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The factual Sam Altman partnership connects these usage signals to the AI platform ecosystem, while Bill Ackman's disclosed affiliation is supplementary rather than central [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman].
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT的信号横跨可测量的产品需求、开发者活动与知识产权创造：应用评分较高且评论基数庞大，模型下载活跃，GitHub参与度高，并形成较大的专利集群 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]。与Sam Altman的事实性合作将这些使用信号连接至AI平台生态；Bill Ackman的披露关联仅属补充，并非核心依据 [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman]。
second_order: NVDA — expanding AI workloads can support accelerator demand
Enterprise AI software — developer and application adoption can broaden paid deployment
Cloud data-center infrastructure — sustained usage implies continuing compute, networking and power requirements
theses.dissent: Download, review and GitHub activity may not translate into incremental high-margin revenue, while the affiliation channel adds little causal evidence.

falsifier.text: Application and developer engagement weaken materially without corresponding growth in commercial AI deployment.

theses.thesis: ACN has only two channels, but both are comparatively concrete: disclosed congressional buying overlaps with a sharp acceleration in recent federal-contract value [congress_buy] [gov_contract_accel]. That combination supports a narrow read on improving government-services demand, though the absence of a third independent operating channel keeps conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: ACN仅有两个渠道，但两者相对具体：披露的国会议员买入与近期联邦合同金额显著加速同时出现 [congress_buy] [gov_contract_accel]。这一组合支持政府服务需求改善的窄幅判断，但由于缺少第三个独立经营信号，置信度仍低。
second_order: Federal IT modernization — contract acceleration suggests continued agency digitization demand
Cloud implementation partners — public-sector modernization can lift migration and integration workloads
Cybersecurity services — larger federal technology programs typically require security integration
theses.dissent: A short burst of contract awards can be timing-related and may not improve margins or recurring commercial demand.

falsifier.text: Federal contract momentum returns toward its prior pace and new congressional disclosures no longer show net buying.

theses.thesis: MRK combines ten Phase 3 starts, an FDA label-expansion signal, substantial lobbying activity and a special-situation catalyst [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [special_situation]. However, four clinical halts create meaningful counterevidence, and relative strength versus SPY is already close to the desk's extended threshold; the alignment merits monitoring rather than chasing.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK同时出现十项III期临床启动、FDA标签扩展信号、较大规模游说活动及特殊情形催化剂 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [special_situation]。但四项临床暂停构成重要反向证据，而且相对SPY的涨幅已接近本台的过度上涨阈值，因此适合观察而不宜追高。
second_order: Clinical-research services — a broad late-stage pipeline supports trial execution demand
Drug-manufacturing capacity — successful label expansion could increase production requirements
Healthcare policy specialists — elevated lobbying indicates continuing regulatory and reimbursement engagement
theses.dissent: The four clinical halts may indicate that pipeline breadth is masking material program-level attrition.

falsifier.text: Additional late-stage programs are halted or the expected label expansion fails to produce measurable commercial uptake.

Retail buzz adds attention rather than fundamental confirmation [retail_buzz]. MSFT — continued accelerator adoption supports cloud AI capacity expansion
Data-center power infrastructure — denser compute deployment raises electricity and cooling requirements

falsifier.text: Earnings or subsequent demand commentary shows slowing accelerator deployment while developer momentum and model-download activity roll over.
